fork_tensor_autograd_lane: branch out from an autograd lane of a PyTorch tensor using the fork function
join_two_autograd_lanes: merge two autograd lanes back together using the join function with a tensor and phony
use_fork_autograd_function: apply the Fork autograd Function directly to detach a tensor and produce a phony output
use_join_autograd_function: apply the Join autograd Function to merge an input tensor with a phony tensor
review_dependency_module: review the dependency module for arbitrary autograd lane branching and merging utilities
